column2: c.h's macro of the lesser of two values, which calls nothing
the C library's close, which returns -1 with errno set
the C library's closedir, which frees what opendir allocated
the C library's fstat, which returns -1 with errno set
the C library's memcpy, which only copies into the caller's buffer
the C library's open, which returns -1 with errno set and allocates nothing
the C library's opendir, or port's on Windows, which allocates with malloc and returns NULL with errno set
port's pread, a system call on Unix and a ReadFile at an offset on Windows, which returns -1 with errno set
the C library's readdir, which returns NULL at the end and sets errno only on a failure
the C library's strcmp, which only reads
the C library's strerror, which returns a static message for an errno
the C library's strlen, which only reads
